description: Train a continuous IQ velocity field from blind posterior to paired clean source IQ with time, dynamic channel backprojection and frozen ground F supervision; fixed 1/4/8-step source evaluation.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 physical GPU2, source-only training, TF32 disabled, mixed L_s/U_s source gradient preflight

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256]; parent posterior, current transport state, estimated-channel backprojection, estimated log noise, flow time
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: L_s fit ID labels only for source supervised loss; U_s clean-F soft outputs only, never U_s true labels, V or test
data.validation_ref: Six impaired scenes x 64 RX8 source physical IDs previously explored in other views; evaluation high-confidence frozen clean-F pseudo labels
data.leo_config_ref: Fixed fresh source cache epochs 21/22/23 train; epoch19 source RX8 evaluation

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Random conditional flow net; blind channel model, source Gaussian prior and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL frozen; DURA only loaded for post-training source comparison.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind action SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338 and source prior SHA256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: 4096 source fit IDs disjoint from prior IDs; three source channel views, final epoch 3; fixed Euler integration steps 1,4,8; source-only pilot and no automatic test.

dimensions: six RX8 source heldout scenes; raw, parent, DURA, 1/4/8 transport steps
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Only L_s fit truth used for supervised source loss; U_s clean-F soft distributions; evaluate pseudo labels not test truth; source physical IDs previously observed.
